data.name: Sabeha
data.gender_notes: Sabeha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sabeha is derived from the Arabic word 'sabr' which means patience and steadfastness. The name Sabeha carries the meaning “Patient” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Sabeha usually hope their child will grow to embody patient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being patient and steadfast is a virtue of a true believer. This name encourages the development of such virtues in the child.
data.etymology: Sabeha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Patient.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabeha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: سبها
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الصباح أو وقت السحر
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سبها هو اسم مؤنث عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'سبح' الذي يعني الطهارة أو العلو. يرمز الاسم إلى بداية جديدة، مثل الصباح الذي يأتي بعد الليل، كما يمكن أن يرتبط بمعنى السحر أو وقت الصلاة في الإسلام. استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على النور والطهارة.

in_urdu.name: سبھا
in_urdu.meaning: صبح یا شام کا وقت، اللہ کی پاکی
in_urdu.long_meaning: سبھا ایک عربی ಮೂಲ کا مؤنث نام ہے جو 'سبح' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پاک کرنا یا شرف و عظمت۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں یہ نام طلوع صبح کی مانند نئی شروعات، یا عبادت و تقرب کے وقت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا استعمال جنوب ایشیائی اسلامی معاشرے میں پاکی، صفائی اور روحانی بلندی کے معنی میں کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सबहा
in_hindi.meaning: सुबह का समय, पवित्रता, और शुद्धि
in_hindi.long_meaning: सबहा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। यह 'सबḥ' क्रिया से व्युत्पन्न है, जिसका अर्थ है पवित्र या पवित्रता। इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सुबह की तरह नई शुरुआत के प्रतीक और आध्यात्मिक पवित्रता के अर्थ में किया जाता है। यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जो इस्लामी मूल्यों में अत्यधिक मायने रखते हैं।

in_pashto.name: سبها
in_pashto.meaning: په سهار یا ماښام کې، د الله پاکۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: سبها د عربي اصل يو نوم دی چی د 'سبح' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې د پاکۍ یا لوړوالی دی. په پښتنو او افغان کلتور کې، دا نوم د سهار د رڼا په معنا کارول کېږي، کوم چی د نوي پیل او پاکۍ ښکارندوی دی. دا نوم په ځانګړي ډول د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي کوم چې د اسلامي فضیلتونو څخه برخمن دي.

in_english.name: Sabeha
in_english.meaning: Morning, purity, and sacredness in Islamic context
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sabeha originates from the Arabic root 's-b-ḥ', which means 'to purify' or 'to elevate'. In Islamic tradition, Sabeha symbolizes a new beginning, similar to the dawn breaking after night. It is associated with spiritual purity and sacredness, reflecting values highly esteemed in Muslim cultures. Historically, the name has been used across various Islamic societies to denote enlightenment and divine proximity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sabeha can be considered an inspiration for individuals to be patient and steadfast in the face of trials and challenges, as the name itself carries a virtuous meaning in the Islamic tradition. It serves as a reminder of the importance of being patient and resilient in one’s daily life, and can be a source of motivation for those who strive to be better versions of themselves.
data.spiritual_significance: Sabeha holds a spiritual meaning in the Islamic tradition as it signifies the ability to endure difficult times with faith and patience. It refers to the innate quality of being steadfast in one’s belief in Allah, and to remain hopeful and optimistic even during moments of hardship. Additionally, Sabeha can be seen as a reminder of the importance of being patient in seeking Allah's blessings, and to trust in His timing and plan. The name is a testament to the belief that with patience and faith, one can overcome any obstacle or trial, and find inner peace and contentment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Sabeha in Islam is believed to have the following meaning: "The one who is in a state of constant remembrance (Dhikr) of Allah." This name reflects a deep commitment to Allah and a focus on maintaining a close connection with the Divine through consistent spiritual practice.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Sabeha bint Jabir ibn Abdullah Al Ansari (d. 652 CE) The name Sabeha carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Sabeha was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a member of the Ansar of Medina. She was known for her generosity and hospitality.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Sabeha remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
